name: labby
description: Rust MCP gateway with Code Mode, authentication, protected routes, setup, logs, CLI, HTTP API, and operator web UI.

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: Base URL of the Labby MCP HTTP server. Defaults to Dookie's host-side production proxy on port 40100; the Incus container listens internally on 8765. For remote use, set this explicitly to the Labby server URL you own or have been instructed to trust. Do NOT include a trailing /mcp — the plugin appends it.

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: Bearer token for MCP HTTP authentication. Matches LABBY_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN on the server. Required when auth_mode is bearer. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32 or just mcp-token in the Labby Justfile.

auth_mode.title: Auth mode
auth_mode.description: Authentication mode the Labby server is running. bearer: static token auth (default, requires api_token). oauth: Google OAuth via the Labby auth server (requires public_url and Google OAuth credentials on the server). Maps to LABBY_AUTH_MODE on the server.

public_url.title: Public URL
public_url.description: Explicit public base URL of the Labby server, e.g. https://lab.example.com. Required for server OAuth and for upstream OAuth: Labby derives the browser callback from this URL and fails closed when it is absent. Never use the MCP server URL or an unconfigured shared host as a callback. Maps to LABBY_PUBLIC_URL on the server.

mcp_gateway_url.title: MCP gateway URL
mcp_gateway_url.description: Separate public base URL for the MCP gateway when it runs on a different hostname from the Labby UI, e.g. https://mcp.example.com. Leave empty when the app and gateway share a hostname (the common case). Maps to LABBY_MCP_GATEWAY_URL on the server.

admin_enabled.title: Enable admin tools
admin_enabled.description: Enable the lab_admin MCP tool for operator-level administration. Requires the lab-admin feature gate compiled in. Maps to LABBY_ADMIN_ENABLED=1 on the server.

log_filter.title: Log filter
log_filter.description: Tracing filter directive for labby serve, e.g. labby=debug,labby_apis=info. Maps to LABBY_LOG on the server. Default keeps Labby at info and SDK at warn to reduce noise.

log_format.title: Log format
log_format.description: Log output format for labby serve: text (human-readable with ANSI color when stderr is a TTY) or json (newline-delimited JSON for prod/CI). Maps to LABBY_LOG_FORMAT on the server.

cors_origins.title: CORS origins
cors_origins.description: Additional CORS origins allowed for the Labby API, comma-separated, e.g. https://lab.example.com,https://mcp.example.com. Loopback origins (localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1]) are always included and do not need to be listed here. Maps to LABBY_CORS_ORIGINS on the server.

auth_provider.title: Inbound OAuth provider
auth_provider.description: Inbound human identity provider: google or authelia. Maps to LABBY_AUTH_PROVIDER on the server.

google_client_id.title: Google OAuth client ID
google_client_id.description: Google OAuth Web Application client ID. Required when auth_mode is oauth. Create a Web application OAuth client in Google Cloud Console. Maps to LABBY_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID on the server.

google_client_secret.title: Google OAuth client secret
google_client_secret.description: Google OAuth client secret. Required when auth_mode is oauth. Maps to LABBY_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET on the server.

authelia_issuer_url.title: Authelia OIDC issuer
authelia_issuer_url.description: Exact HTTPS issuer URL published by Authelia. Maps to LABBY_AUTHELIA_ISSUER_URL on the server.

authelia_client_id.title: Authelia client ID
authelia_client_id.description: Authelia confidential OIDC client ID. Maps to LABBY_AUTHELIA_CLIENT_ID on the server.

authelia_client_secret.title: Authelia client secret
authelia_client_secret.description: Authelia confidential OIDC client secret. Maps to LABBY_AUTHELIA_CLIENT_SECRET on the server.

authelia_trusted_private_origin.title: Trusted private Authelia origin
authelia_trusted_private_origin.description: Exact HTTPS Authelia origin explicitly trusted when the issuer resolves to a private address. Leave empty for public origins. Maps to LABBY_AUTHELIA_TRUSTED_PRIVATE_ORIGIN on the server.

authelia_ca_cert_path.title: Authelia CA certificate path
authelia_ca_cert_path.description: Optional PEM CA bundle trusted only for the exact Authelia issuer origin. Maps to LABBY_AUTHELIA_CA_CERT_PATH on the server.

auth_admin_email.title: OAuth admin email
auth_admin_email.description: Bootstrap allowed Google account for OAuth mode. The server refuses to start OAuth without an allowlisted account. Maps to LABBY_AUTH_ADMIN_EMAIL on the server.
